_comment: What the build cannot learn from the link line, the vcpkg tree and the Qt SBOMs.
Qt modules and what Qt bundles come from qt-modules.json (tools/licences/qt_sbom_manifest.py).
vcpkg ports need no entry: their copyright files are read from the installed tree.
See docs/licensing.md for how this file, the generator (tools/licences/notices.py) and the test fit together.

qt._comment: expectedQtVersion: the Qt series the snapshot was read from. A build against another series fails until qt-modules.json is regenerated and this is reviewed.

fileAliases._comment: Only for libraries the Qt SBOMs do not list as packaged binaries; qt-modules.json 'files' is generated and covers every plugin and module library the SBOMs name.

textExemptions._comment: SPDX ids that need no text of their own in the app.
textExemptions.CC0-1.0: A public-domain dedication: it sets no condition, so no text has to be reproduced.
textExemptions.LicenseRef-Qt-Commercial: The Qt Company's commercial licence is an offer of theirs, not a licence this app is under; there is no text to reproduce.

textAliases._comment: An id whose text is the same file as another's: the GNU General Public License version 3 has one text.

displayNames._comment: How a component that Qt bundles is named in the list; the SBOM's own names are used for the rest (keys are lower case).
